description: Business analysis and technology advisory from Lagos State, Nigeria, for teams at home and abroad. We improve processes, automate work and train analysts.

hero.title: Technology that fits the way your business *works*.
hero.sub: We help organisations in Nigeria and abroad map and improve their processes, automate the repetitive work and choose systems that fit, starting with clear requirements.

sections.label: Advisory
sections.title: Fix the process before you buy the system.
sections.note: Most of what goes wrong in a change was decided before it started: processes nobody mapped, requirements nobody wrote down, systems chosen before the need was clear.

band.title: Tell us what you're working on.
band.note: An idea to test, a process to fix, work to automate or a system to choose. A short call is enough to see where we can help.
